title: Wireless Toolbox
summary: Net tools, WiFi audit, BLE sensors, tracker watch and a BLE sniffer in one app
description:
Wireless Toolbox puts five wireless and network tools behind one menu on the CardputerZero.

• Net Tools — ping monitors, WiFi scan, LAN discovery (ARP + mDNS), port probe. Works out of the box.
• Home Sensors — read nearby BLE sensor beacons (temperature, humidity, door, motion) over the built-in Bluetooth. Works out of the box.
• Tracker Guard — spot unknown AirTag-style trackers that follow you, over the built-in Bluetooth. Works out of the box.
• WiFi Audit — scan 802.11, watch for deauth attacks and more. Needs a USB monitor-mode WiFi adapter; the built-in wlan0 stays your uplink.
• BLE Sniffer — capture Bluetooth LE packets to a Wireshark pcap. Needs an nRF Sniffer dongle.

The three built-in-radio tools run on any unit; the two that need extra hardware show a clear 'plug it in' screen when it isn't found. Key 4 (or Esc) backs out of any tool to the menu.

zh-CN.title: 无线工具箱
zh-CN.summary: 网络工具 + WiFi 分析 + 蓝牙传感器 + 防追踪 + 蓝牙抓包,五合一
zh-CN.description:
无线工具箱把五个无线/网络工具放进 CardputerZero 的一个菜单里。

• Net Tools 网络工具 —— Ping 监控、WiFi 扫描、局域网发现(ARP+mDNS)、端口探测。开箱即用。
• Home Sensors 智能家居 —— 用内置蓝牙读周围 BLE 传感器(温湿度、门磁、人体感应)。开箱即用。
• Tracker Guard 防追踪 —— 用内置蓝牙发现跟着你走的可疑 AirTag 类追踪器。开箱即用。
• WiFi Audit WiFi 分析 —— 扫 802.11、监测 deauth 攻击等。需外接 USB 监听网卡,内置 wlan0 仍做上网。
• BLE Sniffer 蓝牙抓包 —— 把 BLE 数据包抓成 Wireshark pcap。需 nRF 嗅探器 dongle。

三个用内置射频的工具任何机器都能用;两个要外接硬件的,在没插硬件时会给出清晰的「请插入」提示。任意工具里按 4(或 Esc)返回菜单。
